title: Redis client connection limit exhausted
validation_evidence: Synthetic fixture completed; no real Redis change or production evidence.
prerequisites: Confirm sandbox Redis service and approved access; capture current state.
diagnostic_steps: Compare synthetic connection count with configured client limit.
Check sandbox client connection lifecycle and recent changes.
resolution_steps: In the sandbox, correct the lab client connection cleanup configuration after operator review.
validation_steps: Rerun the synthetic client fixture and verify connections return to baseline.
rollback_steps: Restore the previous lab client configuration if validation fails.
stop_conditions: Stop if the environment differs, evidence is missing or privileges are insufficient.

title: Kafka consumer lag rising after rebalance
symptom: Kafka consumer lag rising after rebalance
validation_evidence: Synthetic consumer fixture only; no production change or reliability claim.
prerequisites: Confirm sandbox Kafka scope and read-only consumer-group access.
diagnostic_steps: Inspect synthetic lag per partition and group membership.
Compare rebalance timestamps with synthetic client restart events.
resolution_steps: After sandbox review, correct the test consumer restart schedule and rerun the workload.
validation_steps: Verify stable synthetic group membership and falling lag under unchanged workload.
rollback_steps: Restore the prior test schedule if group stability worsens.
stop_conditions: Stop on production scope, unknown ownership or missing measurements.
